messages:
maya: OrbitCloud sent invoice INV-2026-019 but AP system couldn't match to a PO. says 'no approver found'. Can someone look?

finance-bot: New invoice recorded: INV-2026-019 | Vendor: OrbitCloud | Amount: $12,450.00 | Status: MATCH_FAILED (PO_NOT_FOUND)

liam: I pulled the invoice. Vendor referenced PO `2024-ORBIT-9876` which was archived during vendor consolidation last year.

oliver: Do we have a replacement PO? or should we generate a one-off PO? Vendor is asking for payment status, says aging at 20 days.

maya: Cost center on the invoice is SVC-OPS-EU. Historically that mapped to PO `2025-OPS-4321` after the consolidation. invoice snippet:
```
INV-2026-019
Line 1: Managed infra support - $12,000
Line 2: Misc license fees - $450
PO ref: 2024-ORBIT-9876
Cost center: SVC-OPS-EU
```

procurement-bot: I can remap archived PO references to active POs, but I need a confirmed approver for the current cost center. Who owns SVC-OPS-EU now?

sarah: That's my org. I can be approver for small vendor spend, but >$10k needs director sign-off (Liang). @liam can you approve an exception to expedite?

liam: I can approve as interim for payment, but please confirm GL code (use 5410 - Cloud services) and get director notified. I'll sign once procurement updates the PO link.

maya: Vendor is pressing for remittance by EOD to avoid late fees. Would prefer not to create new PO.

finance-bot: HOLD placed on INV-2026-019 pending PO remap. Escalation sent to AP manager.

sarah: Updated — remapped `2024-ORBIT-9876` -> `2025-OPS-4321` in the system and set approver to Liam (temp). Notified director. Please ack when payment is submitted.

oliver: Ack. I'll queue the payment run for tonight once Liam releases approval.

liam: Approved the mapped invoice in AP (marked GL 5410). Payment scheduled for tonight's run. Leaving note: remap approved by procurement (Sarah).

maya: Thanks team :thumbsup: Vendor notified. Closing thread.
